purpose: Prepare an aggregate-only, post-closeout Train-250 headroom diagnostic for the three A2 primary advancement arms without retrieval, adaptation, provider contact, or spend.

required_runtime_bindings.a2_amended_closeout_receipt: valid A2 v2 PASS closeout with exact 52/40/12 accounting, three primary winner receipt hashes, two diagnostic no-winner hashes, safe return, workers reaped, and protected scan PASS
required_runtime_bindings.a2_result_integrity_audit_receipt: valid aggregate-only PASS audit bound to the amended A2 closeout and amendment
required_runtime_bindings.a1_incumbent_aggregate_receipt: valid frozen PASS aggregate receipt with one Recall@100 OUT value per primary advancement arm

output_boundary: The diagnostic emits only aggregate winner-minus-incumbent Recall@100 OUT deltas for ARM-03, ARM-05, and ARM-04. It cannot promote, select, execute, or tune any candidate.
